text.en: The sitios of Lagdong, Caritan and Bumaga in the Municipality of Balabac, Province of Palawan, are constituted into a district and independent barrio of said municipality, to be known as the Barrio of Salang.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1963.
